statements: The full shell was read on https://app.smartcityos.io (deployed) with the tenant key presented from the environment; the bare visit (no cityKey in the address) resolved to bastrop_tx, and /api/city-packs answered caller.tenant=bastrop_tx.
THE MAP IFRAME MOUNTED on the full-shell pass: #map-site src=/property-map.html?cityKey=bastrop_tx (data-src=/property-map.html?cityKey=bastrop_tx), stage hidden=false, frame box {"w":378,"h":200}.

AND IT RENDERED: inside the frame, url=https://app.smartcityos.io/property-map.html?cityKey=bastrop_tx, #pm-map class="pm-map leaflet-container leaflet-touch leaflet-fade-anim leaflet-grab leaflet-touch-drag leaflet-touch-zoom", 6 of 6 tile images loaded, layer categories=?, layers status="".

The page's own address search for "908 Pine St" settled inside the frame: status="Matched: 908 PINE ST, BASTROP, TX, 78602", address="908 PINE , BASTROP, TX 78602", parcel="34137", zoning="The SF District provides areas for traditional neighborhoods composed primarily of detached single-family homes. It encourages walkable residential character, neighborhood cohesion, and protection of established areas.", and pressing the page's own Search button inside the frame DID reach the wire: 1 /api/property-map/summary request(s) came FROM the frame (http 200). drive={"ok":true,"dockMode":"switched to full","strategies":[{"strategy":"normal fill and click","ok":false,"error":"locator.fill: Timeout 8000ms exceeded."},{"strategy":"switch the frame to its Full dock mode","ok":true},{"strategy":"fill and click in Full, with actionability waived","ok":false,"error":"locator.click: Element is not visible"},{"strategy":"type the address and press the page's own Search button in one step inside the frame","ok":true}]}.

WHAT THE FRAME DOES NOT DO INSIDE THE SHELL, AND WHY THE PROBE HAD TO DRIVE IT BY EVENT: web/property-map.js adds `pm-embedded` to the frame's own <body> when `window.self !== window.top` (read here as embedded=true), and web/property-map.css hides that page's own search form and status line under it (computed display: search form = none, status line = none); the frame's own search button measures {"w":0,"h":0}. So inside the shell the map page's address controls are not offered to a pointer at all -- by the page's own embedded rule, and the shell renders property detail from its own route instead (G-128). The probe reached the page's own search only by firing the page's own control events inside the frame, which is what the last strategy in the ladder records, and every rung that failed is in the artifact with its own error rather than swallowed.

THE SHELL'S OWN PROPERTY PATH, READ ALONGSIDE IT: the shell itself fetched the same route for its dock (web/app.js loadPropertyDock, G-128) -- /api/property-map/summary?address=908%20Pine%20St&cityKey=bastrop_tx answered status="ok" found=true basis="matched: 908 PINE ST, BASTROP, TX, 78602", parcel 34137 on Downtown Bastrop. That request came from the TOP frame, not from the mounted map.
THE MAP'S OWN DATA PATH ANSWERED INSIDE THE SESSION: 16 response(s) on /api/property-map/(summary|layers), 12 of them made FROM the mounted frame, 0 not 200.
